course_name_original: Estructuras De Hormigón Y Mecánica Del Suelo
prerequisites: Knowledge on how to analytically solve isostatic or hyperstatic structures to obtain force laws
Assimilated concepts of stress and strain and their relationship in elastic or plastic materials

learning_outcomes.text: Knowledge and skills to apply the scientific and technological fundamentals of concrete structures and soil mechanics.

syllabus_topics: General and Specific Criteria for Concrete Structures
General Bases for Project and Safety Criteria
Article 10. Limit States Method (Limit States and Service Limit States, Fulfillment of Limit States during useful life)
Article 11. Bases for verification of Durability-related Limit States (General, Identification of environment type, Durability Strategy, Verification of Durability-related Limit States)
Article 26. Specific scope of application for concrete structures.
Article 27. Specific criteria for concrete structures.
Annex 18. Calculation Bases (3. PRINCIPLES OF LIMIT STATES CALCULATION, 4 BASIC VARIABLES, 6 VERIFICATION BY THE PARTIAL COEFFICIENTS METHOD)
Study of the Durability of Concrete Structures
Article 43. Durability strategy in concrete elements.
Article 44. Additional specific considerations based on the exposure class.
Verification and Dimensioning of Concrete Structures
Annex 19. Concrete structures project. General rules and rules for building
8. REINFORCEMENT DETAILS FOR PASSIVE AND ACTIVE REINFORCEMENTS. GENERALITIES
Reinforcement Details of Elements and Particular Rules
9. REINFORCEMENT DETAILS OF ELEMENTS AND PARTICULAR RULES
Design of Shallow and Deep Foundations

assessment_methods.method: Continuous Assessment Tests (Pruebas de Evaluación Continua - PEC)

assessment_rules: The final grade is calculated as 0.8 * P.P. Grade + 0.2 * Continuous Assessment Grade if continuous assessment is chosen and the P.P. grade is at least 3.5 points. If continuous assessment is not chosen, the final grade is solely the P.P. Grade. For the exam, it is necessary to achieve a minimum of 30% of the assigned score in each problem to pass. If the weighted sum of PECs and P.P. is lower than the P.P. grade alone, the P.P. grade will prevail. PEC grades are saved for the September resit period.
